about: The rules of spec/formats/res.md: one shard of the BFBC2 tool suite specification's rule index, written by spec/trace.py --emit; checked by spec/trace.py --check.

evidence.ref: 444,286 live entries of 1,086 bundles grouped by type and extension (round SP1 survey)

DICE's bundles of the game copy (dated before 2013: 1,021), round SPV1 2026-11-22: 392,246 live entries: 37 types (`<non-resource>` on .dbx 124,458, .res 14,694, .dbmanifest 2; every other type on .res only)

the type catalogue's layouts (texture, mesh, Havok, Wave ...) begin with counts and sizes, not identifiers; only the Havok packfile inside its wrapper, the BIGF archive of a SwfMovie and the RES wrapper have magic numbers

rules.title: A resource's kind is its entry type, not its bytes

evidence.ref: 358 HavokPhysicsData resources shared by the console's and the PC's bundles: same size, byte order the only difference (FORMAT.md 1.3)
146 `_HavokAsset.dbx` entries of the Dist level bundles, each with a `_HavokAsset.res` of the same stem (model/bundles.md)

rules.title: A resource sits beside its asset

evidence.ref: Dist streaming_vo_en 7,513, streaming_sounds 4,744; Package streaming_vo_en 1,482, streaming_sounds 955; overlay 25 `.bin`; build_overlay 1 `.dbmanifest` in Dist and 1 in Package

DICE's bundles of the game copy (dated before 2013: 1,021), round SPV1 2026-11-22: the non-DBX `<non-resource>` entries: streaming_sounds 5,699 and streaming_vo_en 8,995 `.res` under sound/, build_overlay 2 `.dbmanifest` (DICE's overlay bundles are OPFOR-changed, not in this corpus)
1,403 wrapped entries: all version 2, the type name equal to the entry type and zero-padded, both length words equal to size - 64; 1,293 of them (all of DICE's) with size2 = size - 64

wrapped: Dist ondemand_awards 889, Package ondemand_awards 295, Dist ondemand_sounds 205, Package ondemand_sounds 14; every `.res` / `.bin` entry of the 1,086 bundles checked, no other begins with `RES`

DICE's bundles of the game copy (dated before 2013: 1,021), round SPV1 2026-11-22: wrapped: ITexture in ondemand_awards 889, Wave in ondemand_sounds 219; no other `.res` / `.bin` entry begins with `RES`

rules.title: Only the async on-demand bundles wrap
Readers strip it, writers of on-demand entries add it
